content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Solana payments enable digital creators to sell products directly to their audience without relying on payment processors that impose steep fees. Unlike Gumroad, which takes a 10% cut on every sale, NOWPayments charges a mere 0.5%. This significant cost reduction means that for a creator selling 100 units of a $97 product, the savings can amount to $921 each month. By leveraging Solana’s blockchain technology, creators gain access to a fast, cost-effective solution that preserves their profits and promotes financial sovereignty.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture for Solana payments involves several components working in tandem to create a seamless user experience. At its core, Solana’s blockchain facilitates rapid transactions at low costs, while NOWPayments handles the crypto payment verification. The combination of GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages as a hosting solution, alongside Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, allows creators to automate product delivery efficiently. This infrastructure not only ensures secure transactions but also provides complete ownership of the data, eliminating reliance on third-party services.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This payment solution is designed specifically for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are restricted or unavailable. From ebook authors in Nigeria to course instructors in Kenya, these creators need a way to monetize their digital products without incurring crippling fees. Solana payments empower them to take control of their sales, ensuring that they keep a larger share of their revenue. This architecture is ideal for anyone looking to establish a sustainable online business in environments where traditional payment methods fail.
Gumroad's 10% fee can cripple your profits—NOWPayments charges just 0.5%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The complete infrastructure involves key components that make the system function effectively. Hosting is managed through GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, providing free and reliable access. Backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, enabling automated delivery of products. Order storage can be managed through Supabase or Google Sheets, while NOWPayments offers a straightforward integration for crypto payment processing. Together, these elements create a cohesive stack that allows creators to operate independently and retain full control over their sales.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start using Solana payments for your digital products, first, select your hosting solution, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate product delivery. Integrate NOWPayments for handling crypto transactions. Utilize Supabase or Google Sheets for order management, ensuring a smooth transaction process. Finally, test your setup thoroughly and promote your newly deployed digital store. For comprehensive guidance, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates for deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Retain full ownership of your digital products with sovereign commerce infrastructure.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell digital products without the burden of platform fees, Solana payments provide a viable solution. Explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for everything you need to build and deploy your digital commerce stack effectively.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
